prompt: Create a new vehicle page from scratch for Cobalt Receipt — a small Tessarine courier boat that runs sealed ledgers between factor houses, recognized by a blue-painted stern board and a bell that only rings in fog. Mark all of this as invention; it is not in the campaign wiki. Use wiki/templates/vehicle.md including Sheet and Components minima. Show a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/.
expected_output: A new vehicle page labeled invention:true that follows vehicle.md, with identity sentence, narration (silhouette/scale/access), filled Sheet and Hull/Helm/Movement components, crew stations, and handling. No claim Cobalt Receipt exists in vault canon.

assertions.text: Frontmatter includes type: vehicle, kind (ship|boat|other), and required identity fields (lifecycle, reveal, campaign, visibility, summary)
Invention is labeled with invention: true or clearly marked as proposed, not presented as vault canon
Identity sentence appears before the page draft
Shows a chat proposal / work gate before writing under wiki/
Sheet fills Size, Type, Speed, Crew (min), Passengers, Cargo so the craft can enter play
